name: dateCompare
description: Compares two dates to a given optional resolution
syntax: dateCompare( datetime date1, datetime date2, [string datePart] )

params.name: datePart
params.description:
Precision of the comparison:

- s (default): Precise to the second
- n: Precise to the minute
- h: Precise to the hour
- d: Precise to the day
- m: Precise to the month
- yyyy: Precise to the year
